title: A Semantics-First Approach to Multimodal Video Captioning with Frozen Encoders and Stabilized Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.33409v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose the Audio-Visual Query Transformer (AVQFormer), a highly efficient architecture built upon a 2.7B parameter LLM featuring a fixed-length $K=16$ semantic alignment module, stabilized via Adaptive Self-Critical Sequence Training (ASCST) with Entropy Regularization. Multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) often rely on global audio representations to compensate for inefficient, frame-based visual encoders. While our Phase 1 prompted evaluations demonstrate that the Multimodal Base Model achieves strong deep semantic alignment (scoring 0.889 on BERTScore F1), optimizing this architecture for legacy metrics reveals a performance gap. translated_abstract: 我们提出了音视频查询Transformer（AVQFormer），这是一种基于27亿参数大语言模型构建的高效架构，其核心特点是采用固定长度K=16的语义对齐模块，并通过带熵正则化的自适应自我批判序列训练（ASCST）实现稳定化。多模态大语言模型通常依赖全局音频表征来弥补低效的基于帧的视觉编码器。虽然我们的第一阶段提示评估表明，该多模态基础模型实现了强大的深层语义对齐（BERTScore F1得分0.889），但在针对传统指标优化该架构时暴露出性能差距。我们将这一差距作为假设进行探讨，称之为“时间对齐摩擦”：即全局音频表征破坏视觉帧的时间顺序，导致在以视觉为中心的评估指标下受到惩罚的一种冲突。因此，通过剥离音频，我们的纯视频消融（实验）……
tldr: 提出AVQFormer架构，在27亿参数LLM上通过固定长度语义对齐模块与稳定化强化学习（ASCST）实现高效多模态视频描述，并揭示全局音频表征与视觉帧时序冲突导致的“时间对齐摩擦”现象。
en_tdlr: Proposes AVQFormer, an efficient multimodal video captioning architecture built on a 2.7B LLM with a fixed-length semantic alignment module and stabilized reinforcement learning (ASCST), while identifying "temporal alignment friction" where global audio representations disrupt the chronological order of visual frames.
